def search(depth, alpha, beta, ply, can_null):
    global NODES
    NODES += 1
    if (NODES & 255) == 0 and perf_counter() > DEADLINE:
        raise Timeout
    h = HASH
    if h in PATHSET or h in HISTGAME:
        return 0
    if ply >= 96:
        return evaluate()
    white = WTM
    ksq = WK if white else BK
    in_chk = ksq >= 0 and attacked(BD, ksq, not white)
    if in_chk:
        depth += 1
    if depth <= 0:
        return qsearch(alpha, beta, ply)
    PATHSET.add(h)
    try:
        tt_move = None
        e = TT.get(h)
        if e is not None:
            ed, ef, esc, emv = e
            tt_move = emv
            if ed >= depth:
                if esc >= MATE_BOUND:
                    esc -= ply
                elif esc <= -MATE_BOUND:
                    esc += ply
                if ef == 0:
                    return esc
                if ef == 1:
                    if esc >= beta:
                        return esc
                elif esc <= alpha:
                    return esc
        if can_null and not in_chk and depth >= 3 and beta < MATE_BOUND \
                and (NPMW if white else NPMB) >= 400:
            o = make_null()
            sc = -search(depth - 3, -beta, -beta + 1, ply + 1, False)
            unmake_null(o)
            if sc >= beta:
                ttstore(h, depth, 1, beta, None, ply)
                return beta
        moves = gen_pseudo(BD, white, EP, CASTLE, in_chk)
        scored = []
        for m in moves:
            scored.append((mscore(m, tt_move, ply), m))
        scored.sort(reverse=True)
        a = alpha
        best = -INF
        bestmove = None
        legal = 0
        for _s, m in scored:
            frm = m[0]
            to = m[1]
            mt = in_chk or frm == ksq or m[2] == 2 or (ksq >= 0 and ALIGN[(frm << 7) + ksq] != 0)
            quiet = (BD[to] == 0 and m[2] != 2 and not m[3])
            old = make(m)
            if mt and ksq >= 0:
                k2 = WK if white else BK
                if attacked(BD, k2, not white):
                    unmake(old)
                    continue
            legal += 1
            if legal == 1:
                sc = -search(depth - 1, -beta, -a, ply + 1, True)
            else:
                sc = -search(depth - 1, -a - 1, -a, ply + 1, True)
                if a < sc < beta:
                    sc = -search(depth - 1, -beta, -a, ply + 1, True)
            unmake(old)
            if sc > best:
                best = sc
                bestmove = m
                if sc > a:
                    a = sc
                    if a >= beta:
                        if quiet:
                            kl = KILLERS[ply]
                            if kl[0] != m:
                                kl[1] = kl[0]
                                kl[0] = m
                            hi = (frm << 7) + to
                            if HISTTBL[hi] < 8000000:
                                HISTTBL[hi] += depth * depth
                        ttstore(h, depth, 1, sc, m, ply)
                        return sc
        if legal == 0:
            sc = -(MATE - ply) if in_chk else 0
            ttstore(h, depth, 0, sc, None, ply)
            return sc
        ttstore(h, depth, 0 if best > alpha else 2, best, bestmove, ply)
        return best
    finally:
        PATHSET.discard(h)
